text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Hello. I'm here to clarify any questions you might have about the Grand Concert and how to train for it.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: So, do you have any questions for me?
choice_data_list: Yes, I'd like to know more.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: What would you like to know about?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm still unclear about…

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Right, the Grand Concert.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: It was an event put together by the students themselves.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, it faded away once the URA normalized winning concerts, and now not many people know about it.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Which is why you'll need to get the word out by holding promo concerts. ♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: You'll hold a total of four of these, and each concert's reception will be determined by how many new songs are performed.
color_text_info_list: determined by how many new songs are performed.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: A successful concert will be a boon to the students' growth.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Make sure you learn as many new songs as possible to ensure eventual success at the Grand Concert.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: And don't forget, your trainee will also be racing in the Twinkle Series while you're preparing for all those performances.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: If you're not careful in meeting your goals, her career may be over before you ever get to the Grand Concert!
color_text_info_list: her career may be over before you ever get to the Grand Concert!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Is there anything else you'd like to know?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Ah, performance points.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: After a successful training session, you'll gain one of five types of performance points.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Different training types will give you different types of performance points each time, so be sure to check your options.
color_text_info_list: give you different types of performance points each time

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: The amount of points you earn also depends on the level of the training and the number of Umamusume you train with.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Friendship Training will even give you two types of performance points at once!
color_text_info_list: give you two types of performance points at once

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Certain events will also give you performance points. ♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: You'll need points to learn songs and concert techniques, so earn as many as possible!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Is there anything else you'd like to know?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Ah, lessons.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Lessons are where your trainee will learn new songs and concert techniques with the performance points you've earned.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: After learning a new song or concert technique, you'll also acquire a Mastery Bonus. ♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: These bonuses can boost abilities, recover Energy, improve training effectiveness, and more!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: In short, lessons offer nothing but benefits for your trainee, so make good use of them. ♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Learning a new song will additionally grant you a Concert Bonus.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: These bonuses will provide beneficial effects after your next promo concert.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: They offer different benefits from Mastery Bonuses, so keep an eye out for both types. ♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: But keep in mind that you can only learn so many songs in between concerts!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: If a lesson catches your eye but you don't have enough performance points, you can schedule it.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Scheduling a lesson will let you see which performance points you need while training. Convenient, isn't it? ♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: That's all you need to know about lessons. Is there anything else you'd like to know?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Okay. ♪ I've prepared a summary of everything you need to know, just in case.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: If you ever need a refresher, just tap the "i" button in the top left of the screen.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Well, that's all from me. Good luck—I'll be rooting for you!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Okay, well, good luck—I'll be rooting for you!
